Signatures and parameters of every component. To see them with images and examples,
go to the [Components](/pyzed/components/overview/) section.

They are all functions that return a `Widget` and read their colors from the current theme.
Color parameters accept a theme **token** (`"accent"`, `"text_muted"`,
`"error"`…) or a hex color.

## Basics

### `label`

```python
label(
    content,
    *,
    color='text',
    size='md',
    weight=None,
    mono=False,
    italic=False,
    wrap=True,
    theme=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Text with a theme color.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `color` | Theme token or hex color. Defaults to `"text"`. |
| `size` | `"xs"` (11), `"sm"` (12), `"md"` (13.5), `"lg"` (16), `"xl"` (20), `"2xl"` (26) or a number. |
| `weight` | Weight: `"medium"`, `"semibold"`, `"bold"`… |
| `mono` | Uses the monospace font (IBM Plex Mono). |
| `italic` | Italic. |
| `wrap` | Line wrapping. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |
| `kwargs` | Passed to `pyzed.text`. |

### `muted`

```python
muted(content, **kwargs)
```

A `label` with the `"text_muted"` color.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `kwargs` | Same as `label`. |

### `heading`

```python
heading(content, *, level=1, theme=None, **kwargs)
```

A semibold heading.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `level` | 1 (26 px), 2 (20 px), 3 (16 px) or 4 (13.5 px). |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |
| `kwargs` | Same as `label`. |

### `button`

```python
button(
    content=None,
    on_press=None,
    *,
    icon=None,
    icon_position='start',
    icon_color=None,
    variant='filled',
    tint=None,
    size='md',
    selected=False,
    disabled=False,
    full_width=False,
    keys=None,
    theme=None,
    **style,
)
```

The Zed button.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Text or widget. |
| `on_press` | Message or callable sent on press. `None` disables the control. |
| `icon` | Name of a Lucide icon (`pyzed icons` lists them). |
| `icon_position` | `"start"` or `"end"`. |
| `icon_color` | Icon color: a theme token or a hex color. |
| `variant` | `"filled"`, `"ghost"`, `"subtle"`, `"outline"`, `"solid"`, `"tinted"`, or a semantic color: `"accent"`, `"error"`, `"warning"`, `"success"`, `"info"`. |
| `tint` | Color for the `solid` and `tinted` variants. |
| `size` | `"xs"`, `"sm"`, `"md"` or `"lg"`. |
| `selected` | Marks it as selected. |
| `disabled` | Disables it (ignores clicks). |
| `full_width` | Fills the full width. |
| `keys` | Shortcut shown at the end, Zed style: `"ctrl-s"`, `"cmd-k cmd-s"`. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |
| `style` | Any `pyzed.button` style parameter (`bg`, `hover_bg`, `color`…). |

| `disabled` | Disables it (ignores clicks). |
| `tooltip` | Tooltip text. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `kbd`

```python
kbd(keys, *, size='sm', theme=None)
```

Draws a shortcut as keys: `"ctrl-shift-p"`, `"cmd-k cmd-s"`. Uses symbols on macOS (⌘⇧P) and words elsewhere.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `keys` | The shortcut. |
| `size` | `"xs"` or `"sm"`. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `format_keys`

```python
format_keys(keys)
```

Splits a shortcut into labels per chord: `format_keys("ctrl-shift-p") == [["Ctrl", "Shift", "P"]]`. The style is controlled by `pyzed.ui.base.KEY_STYLE` (`"auto"`, `"symbols"` or `"words"`).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `keys` | The shortcut. |

## Forms

### `input`

```python
input(
    value,
    on_input=None,
    *,
    placeholder='',
    icon=None,
    on_submit=None,
    id=None,
    size='md',
    secure=False,
    width='fill',
    borderless=False,
    mono=False,
    theme=None,
)
```

A text field.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | Current text. |
| `on_input` | Callable that receives the new text on every keystroke. |
| `placeholder` | Hint text shown when empty. |
| `icon` | Name of a Lucide icon (`pyzed icons` lists them). |
| `on_submit` | Message or callable sent when Enter is pressed. |
| `id` | Stable identifier used to focus or scroll it with a `Command`. |
| `size` | `"sm"`, `"md"` or `"lg"`. |
| `secure` | Hides the text. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `borderless` | No border or background (as in the command palette). |
| `mono` | Uses the monospace font (IBM Plex Mono). |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

## Dialogs

### `dialog_layer`

```python
dialog_layer(base, dialog=None, *, on_dismiss=None, theme=None)
```

Shows a dialog centered over `base` with a dimmed backdrop. With `dialog=None` it returns `base` unchanged, so it can always wrap the view. See [Dialogs](/pyzed/guides/i18n/#dialogs).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The UI underneath. |
| `dialog` | A dialog from the functions below, or `ui.modal`. |
| `on_dismiss` | Sent when the backdrop is clicked. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

```python
ui.dialog_layer(self.main_view(), ui.confirm("Delete 3 files?", self.delete, self.cancel, danger=True)
                if self.asking else None, on_dismiss=self.cancel)
```

### `alert`

```python
alert(message, on_close, *, title=None, kind=None, ok_label=None, width=400, theme=None)
```

A message with one button.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `message` | Text or widget. |
| `on_close` | The button and the close icon. |
| `title` | Title. |
| `kind` | `"info"`, `"success"`, `"warning"` or `"error"` adds an icon. |
| `ok_label` | Button text (default: OK, translated). |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

## Controls

### `select`

```python
select(
    options,
    selected=None,
    on_select=None,
    *,
    placeholder='Select…',
    width=None,
    size='md',
    theme=None,
)
```

A dropdown with the theme style (Zed's `DropdownMenu`). Options are displayed with `str()`, so strings, enums or dataclasses all work.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `options` | List of options. |
| `selected` | Current option. |
| `on_select` | Callable that receives the chosen item. |
| `placeholder` | Hint text shown when empty. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `size` | `"sm"`, `"md"` or `"lg"`. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `radio_group`

radio_group(

### `number_field`

```python
number_field(
    value,
    on_change=None,
    *,
    min=None,
    max=None,
    step=1,
    width=120,
    suffix=None,
    align='center',
    theme=None,
)
```

A numeric field with −/+ buttons (Zed's `NumericStepper`). `on_change(value)` receives the number already clamped to `min`/`max`; anything that can't be parsed as a number is ignored.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | Current value. |
| `on_change` | Callable that receives the new value. |
| `min` | Minimum. |
| `max` | Maximum. |
| `step` | Button step. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `suffix` | Unit shown at the end (`"px"`, `"%"`…). |
| `align` | Where the number sits between the buttons: `"center"` (default), `"start"` or `"end"`. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `AccordionSection`

```python
class AccordionSection
```

One section of `ui.accordion`: `key`, `title`, `content` and optional `icon` and header `end` widget.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `key` | Key that identifies the subscription (defaults to the message or the function). |
| `title` | Title. |

### `accordion`

```python
accordion(
    sections,
    *,
    open=(),
    on_toggle=None,
    icons=None,
    spacing=8,
    padding=(6, 12, 10, 12),
    theme=None,
)
```

Stacked collapsible sections separated by dividers, like the panels of Zed's settings. Each header spans the whole width, so the content lines up with the rest of the panel. You own the open state: change it in `on_toggle`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sections` | `ui.AccordionSection(key, title, content, icon=None, end=None)` items (or `(key, title, content)` tuples). |
| `open` | The set of open ids, a `{id: bool}` dict, or `True` for all. |
| `on_toggle` | Called with the key of the clicked header. |
| `icons` | `{id: icon}`: a Lucide icon for each header. |
| `spacing` | Space around the dividers between sections. |
| `padding` | Padding around the content of an open section. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

```python
ui.accordion([
    ui.AccordionSection("layout", "Layout", layout_rows, icon="ruler"),
    ui.AccordionSection("events", "Events", event_rows, icon="zap"),
], open=self.open_sections, on_toggle=lambda key: self.open_sections.symmetric_difference_update({key}))
```

| `title` | Title. |
| `description` | Secondary text. |
| `icon` | Name of a Lucide icon (`pyzed icons` lists them). |
| `actions` | Extra widgets (usually buttons) shown as actions. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `settings_group`

```python
settings_group(title, rows, *, description=None, theme=None)
```

A titled block of `ui.field` rows separated by lines (Zed's settings UI).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Group title. |
| `rows` | The rows (usually `ui.field`). |
| `description` | Secondary text. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `Column`

```python
@dataclass
class Column(title, key, width='fill', align='start', render=None, sortable=True)
```

A column of `ui.table`. `key` is a dict key, an attribute name or a function of the row; `render` (optional) turns the value into a widget. `width` is `"fill"`, a number or `("fill", 2)`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Header (and name used for sorting). |
| `key` | How to get the value from each row. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `align` | `"start"`, `"center"` or `"end"`. |
| `render` | Function value → widget. |
| `sortable` | Whether the header can be clicked to sort. |

### `table`

```python
table(
    columns,
    rows,
    *,
    sort_by=None,
    descending=False,
    on_sort=None,
    on_row_press=None,
    selected=None,
    striped=False,
    row_height=30,
    height=None,
    theme=None,
)
```

A data table with a fixed header, optional sorting and row selection. Sorting happens here when `sort_by` names a column: clicking a header calls `on_sort(title)` and you update `sort_by`/`descending` in your state.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `columns` | `ui.Column` or plain keys. |
| `rows` | Dicts or objects. |
| `sort_by` | Title of the column to sort by. |
| `descending` | Descending order. |
| `on_sort` | Callable that receives the clicked title. |
| `on_row_press` | Callable that receives the clicked row. |
| `selected` | The highlighted row. |
| `striped` | Shaded alternating rows. |
| `row_height` | Height of each row. |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

## Lists, tree and menus

### `list_item`

```python
list_item(
    content,
    on_press=None,
    *,
    icon=None,
    icon_color=None,
    start=None,
    end=None,
    selected=False,
    focused=False,
    indent=0,
    height=26,
    color=None,
    inset=False,
    disabled=False,
    on_right_press=None,
    theme=None,
)
```

A list row (Zed's `ListItem`): icon, text and a slot at the end.

| `icon_color` | Icon color: a theme token or a hex color. |
| `start` | Widgets at the start (left). |
| `end` | Widgets at the end (right). |

| `focused` | Draws a focus border. |
| `indent` | Left indentation, in pixels. |
| `height` | Row height. |
| `color` | Text color. |
| `inset` | With margin and rounded corners (menus, palettes). |
| `disabled` | Disables it (ignores clicks). |
| `on_right_press` | Right click. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `TreeNode`

```python
@dataclass
class TreeNode(name, children=None, id=None, status=None, icon=None, icon_color=None)
```

A file or folder for `ui.tree`. Folders have `children` (a list). `status` is `"modified"`, `"created"`, `"deleted"`, `"conflict"` or `"ignored"`. `TreeNode.from_paths(paths, status=None)` builds the tree from paths like `"src/main.rs"`, with folders first and the git status propagated to folders.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | Display name. |
| `children` | Children (`None` for a file). |
| `id` | Stable identifier used to focus or scroll it with a `Command`. |
| `status` | Git status. |
| `icon` | Name of a Lucide icon (`pyzed icons` lists them). |
| `icon_color` | Icon color: a theme token or a hex color. |

### `tree`

```python
tree(
    nodes,
    *,
    expanded,
    selected=None,
    on_toggle=None,
    on_select=None,
    indent=14,
    item_height=24,
    theme=None,
)
```

A collapsible file tree (Zed's project panel).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `nodes` | List of `TreeNode`. |
| `expanded` | Set of open folder ids. |
| `selected` | Id of the selected node. |
| `on_toggle` | Called with the id of the clicked folder. |
| `on_select` | Called with the id of the clicked file. |
| `indent` | Left indentation, in pixels. |
| `item_height` | Height of each row. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `MenuItem`

@dataclass

An entry of `ui.menu`.

## Overlays

### `layer`

```python
layer(
    base,
    overlay=None,
    *,
    on_dismiss=None,
    backdrop=None,
    align_x='center',
    align_y='start',
    offset=72,
)
```

Stacks `overlay` on top of `base`. Clicking outside sends `on_dismiss`. With `overlay=None` it returns `base` unchanged.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The UI underneath. |
| `overlay` | What floats on top (modal, palette, menu). |
| `on_dismiss` | Message or callable sent on close. |
| `backdrop` | Color of the backdrop that dims the UI. |
| `align_x` | Horizontal alignment: `"start"`/`"left"`, `"center"`, `"end"`/`"right"`. |
| `align_y` | Vertical alignment: `"start"`/`"top"`, `"center"`, `"end"`/`"bottom"`. |
| `offset` | Distance from the top when `align_y` is `"start"`. |

### `modal`

```python
modal(content, *, title=None, on_close=None, width=480, footer=(), theme=None)
```

A dialog. Use it as the `overlay` of `ui.layer`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | Content: a `Widget`, a string or a number (converted to text). |
| `title` | Title. |
| `on_close` | Message or callable sent when the X is pressed. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `footer` | Footer buttons, aligned to the right. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

| `on_submit` | Message or callable sent when Enter is pressed. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `max_height` | Maximum height in pixels. |
| `empty_text` | Text shown when there are no results. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `fuzzy_match`

```python
fuzzy_match(query, candidate)
```

Returns `(score, positions)` if every letter of `query` appears in order in `candidate`; otherwise `None`. Rewards word starts and consecutive letters.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | Search text. |
| `candidate` | Candidate text. |

### `fuzzy_filter`

```python
fuzzy_filter(query, items, key=<class 'str'>)
```

Filters and sorts `items` by fuzzy score. Returns `[(item, positions), ...]`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `query` | Search text. |
| `items` | Items. |
| `key` | Function that returns the text of each item. |

### `highlighted`

```python
highlighted(text, positions, *, color, match_color, size=13.5, weight=None)
```

Text with the characters at `positions` highlighted (fuzzy search matches).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | Text. |
| `positions` | Indices to highlight. |
| `color` | Text or icon color. |
| `match_color` | Color of the matches. |
| `size` | Size. |
| `weight` | Text weight. |

### `toast`

```python
toast(
    title,
    message=None,
    *,
    kind='info',
    icon=None,
    on_dismiss=None,
    actions=(),
    width=340,
    theme=None,
)
```

A notification.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Title. |
| `message` | Secondary text. |
| `kind` | `"info"`, `"success"`, `"warning"` or `"error"`. |
| `icon` | Name of a Lucide icon (`pyzed icons` lists them). |
| `on_dismiss` | Message or callable sent on close. |
| `actions` | Extra widgets (usually buttons) shown as actions. |
| `width` | Width: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `toasts`

```python
toasts(base, items, *, spacing=8)
```

Shows `items` (usually `toast(...)`) stacked in the bottom-right corner over `base`.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The UI underneath. |
| `items` | List of toasts. |
| `spacing` | Space between children, in pixels. |

### `popover`

```python
popover(base, content=None, *, x=0, y=0, on_dismiss=None)
```

Shows `content` (a `ui.menu`, a card…) over `base` at `(x, y)`. Clicking anywhere else calls `on_dismiss`. For a right-click menu, store the mouse position with `mouse_area(on_move=...)` and open the popover from `on_right_press` (see `examples/context_menu.py`).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The UI underneath. |
| `content` | What floats (or `None`). |
| `x` | Horizontal position. |
| `y` | Vertical position. |
| `on_dismiss` | Message or callable sent on close. |

## Code

### `editor`

```python
editor(
    id,
    text='',
    *,
    language=None,
    path=None,
    on_change=None,
    on_cursor=None,
    markers=None,
    font_size=None,
    line_height=None,
    gutter=True,
    wrap=False,
    active_line=True,
    height='fill',
    placeholder=None,
    annotations=None,
    show_whitespace=False,
    tab_size=None,
    capture_keys=(),
    on_scroll=None,
    theme=None,
)
```

Zed's code editor: highlighting with the theme colors, line numbers and git markers.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Identifies the buffer (use the file path). |
| `text` | Initial text. |
| `language` | Language. If missing, it is inferred from `path`. |
| `path` | File path. |
| `on_change` | Callable that receives the new value. |
| `on_cursor` | Callable that receives `(line, column)`. |
| `markers` | `{line: "created" | "modified" | "deleted"}`. |
| `font_size` | Font size (defaults to the theme's). |
| `line_height` | Line height. |
| `gutter` | Shows line numbers. |
| `wrap` | Line wrapping. |
| `active_line` | Background color of the cursor line. |
| `height` | Height: pixels, `"fill"`, `"shrink"` or `"fill:N"` (proportion). |
| `placeholder` | Hint text shown when empty. |
| `on_scroll` | Called on scroll. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `language_token`

```python
language_token(path)
```

Returns the highlighter language token for a path (`"main.rs"` → `"rs"`).

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | File path. |

### `terminal`

```python
terminal(lines, *, font_size=13, id=None, theme=None)
```

A read-only terminal view with ANSI colors. It stays scrolled to the end.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `lines` | Text with ANSI escapes, or a list of lines of `(text, color)` segments. |
| `font_size` | Font size. |
| `id` | Stable identifier used to focus or scroll it with a `Command`. |
| `theme` | Theme to use instead of the current one (`pyzed.theme.current()`). |

### `ansi`

```python
ansi(text)
```

Converts text with ANSI colors into lines of `(text, color_name)` segments.

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | Text with ANSI escapes. |
